race.comment: MALDINI (4) switched to the Theodore stable two back and has been ridden on pace which is a new role. Led for home but offered little last start over 1522m at this track. Fancy his chances if they take a sit behind a couple of go-forward types who are engaged. SHADOW EAGLE (8) gapped them two back at Murray Bridge then almost made it two in a row when edged out over today's course and distance most recently. Rock-hard fit after three runs back and in a similar race today can go one better. ALPINE FLYER (3) was only 2.9 lengths away in the Gawler Cup last start which is decent form for a race like this. Hasn't won since August 2024 but this is not out of reach. SHADY THINKER (2) is another big chance after two narrow misses in a row at this track.
